mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.type, n.from_user_id, n.post_id, n.comment_id, n.is_read, n.created_at, u.nickname AS from_nickname, u.icon AS from_icon, p.title AS post_title, -- 必须带出帖子状态：帖子被作者**软删除**后行还在、post_title 永远有值， -- 光靠"标题为空"判断不出"帖子已删"，通知里会把已删帖的真实标题显示出来 p.status AS post_status, LEFT(c.content, 60) AS comment_snippet FROM notification n LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = n.from_user_id LEFT JOIN post p ON p.id = n.post_id LEFT JOIN `comment` c ON c.id = n.comment_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC
